The Spurs defeated the Jazz, 117-111 tonight in Utah. Victor Wembanyama finished with a team-high 36 points along with 14 rebounds and 5 assists for the Spurs, while Devin Vassell tallied 21 points, 5 rebounds and 3 steals in the game. Keyonte George recorded 31 points, 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds. The Spurs improve their record to 3-2 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-4 for the season.
